proof_scope: local request validation, draft preparation, fail-closed claim gating, bounded human attestation, own-profile sync planning, and named-contact graph capture planning through the real CLI; no live LinkedIn network or browser access

claims.proves: the skill prepares typed local handoffs, refuses unsupported evidence-sensitive requests, never upgrades a human attestation into platform verification, exports an editable ops-linkedin.profile_entry.v1 JSON from RESUME.md, emits a source-derived own-profile Surf sync plan whose execution_claim remains NOT_EXECUTED, and emits a bounded named-contact graph capture plan that prohibits connecting and sending InMail/messages; additionally: outbound actions without a permitting roundtable verdict are BLOCKED_MISSING_ROUNDTABLE, DO_NOT_SEND and NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION cannot yield an executable packet, a single PASSing seat is rejected as not a panel, sequential topology is rejected as a pipeline, a verified claim without a canonical claim_key is rejected, and profile-update is correctly exempt from the outbound gate
claims.does_not_prove: that LinkedIn accepted, displayed, sent, or delivered any action, that Surf executed the own-profile plan, that Surf executed the contact-graph plan, that any mutual contact exists, or that an official LinkedIn API integration is authorized; it also does not prove that a roundtable actually ran — the packet records a receipt path, it does not execute the panel

cases.name: editable-profile-entry-derived-from-resume
command: d=$(mktemp -d); bash ../run.sh profile-entry-export --resume-source ../../../RESUME.md --profile-url https://www.linkedin.com/in/grahamanderson/ -o $d/profile-entry.json >/dev/null; grep -E '"schema_version": "ops-linkedin.profile_entry.v1"|"location": "Buffalo, NY \(EST\)"|"name": "Graham Anderson"' $d/profile-entry.json

cases.name: profile-sync-plan-consumes-editable-json-without-execution
command: d=$(mktemp -d); bash ../run.sh profile-entry-export --resume-source ../../../RESUME.md --profile-url https://www.linkedin.com/in/grahamanderson/ -o $d/profile-entry.json >/dev/null; bash ../run.sh profile-sync-plan --entry-json $d/profile-entry.json --accept-account-risk --own-profile-only -o $d/profile-sync.json >/dev/null; grep -E '"schema_version": "ops-linkedin.profile_sync.v1"|"external_effects": false|"execution_claim": "NOT_EXECUTED"' $d/profile-sync.json

cases.name: profile-sync-plan-requires-risk-and-own-profile-acknowledgement
command: d=$(mktemp -d); bash ../run.sh profile-entry-export --resume-source ../../../RESUME.md --profile-url https://www.linkedin.com/in/grahamanderson/ -o $d/profile-entry.json >/dev/null; bash ../run.sh profile-sync-plan --entry-json $d/profile-entry.json 2>&1; echo EXIT=$?

cases.name: contact-graph-plan-is-read-only-and-not-executed
command: d=$(mktemp -d); bash ../run.sh contact-graph-capture-plan --opportunity 'Moog Senior AI Engineer' --target 'George Small|Moog|https://www.linkedin.com/in/george-small-moog/' --user-authorized-read-only --accept-account-risk --tab-id 837413494 -o $d/contact-plan.json >/dev/null; grep -E '"schema_version": "ops-linkedin.contact_graph_capture_plan.v1"|"authorization": "USER_AUTHORIZED_READ_ONLY_ACCOUNT_RISK_ACCEPTED"|"execution_claim": "NOT_EXECUTED"|send any message/InMail|connect' $d/contact-plan.json

cases.name: unsupported-profile-claim-fails-closed
command: d=$(mktemp -d); bash ../run.sh prepare ../assets/examples/profile-update-blocked.json -o $d/p.json >/dev/null; rc=$?; grep BLOCKED_UNVERIFIED_CLAIMS $d/p.json; echo EXIT=$rc

cases.name: attestation-without-explicit-confirmation-is-refused
command: d=$(mktemp -d); bash ../run.sh prepare ../assets/examples/publish-post.json -o $d/p.json >/dev/null; bash ../run.sh attest $d/p.json --actor eval 2>&1; echo EXIT=$?

cases.name: human-attestation-never-claims-platform-proof
command: d=$(mktemp -d); bash ../run.sh prepare ../assets/examples/publish-post.json -o $d/p.json >/dev/null; bash ../run.sh attest $d/p.json --actor eval --confirm-human-completed -o $d/c.json >/dev/null; grep -E '"execution_claim": "USER_ATTESTED_MANUAL_ACTION"|"platform_verified": false' $d/c.json
